A '''stronghold''' on [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]] served as [[Sise Fromm]]'s base of operations during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. The base was destroyed in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] when the resistance fighter [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] sabotaged the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang's]] weapons [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]], the ''[[Trigon One]]'', sending it on a collision course with the stronghold. Fromm was able to evacuate shortly before the impact turned the structure into a crater.
